    inside_words = 0

                    outside_max = count

            count = 0

            zone = OUT
            if count > 0:
                inside_words += 1
            count = 0
        else:
            count += 1
    if zone == OUT and count > outside_max:
        outside_max = count
    print(outside_max, inside_words)

if __name__ == "__main__":
